title: custodian paths table v1
description: The routes a project declares: named declaration sets, and the raw paths a job may name.

additionalProperties.description: One declaration set: a glob, one directory and a file pattern in it, written once per glob.

decl.description: Declaration sets by name: each key a set's name (decl:<name>), each value a glob, one directory and a file pattern in it. A name repeats once per glob.

path.description: A raw path, relative to the root, a job may name as path:<raw>. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

ignore.description: A path no count walks into, in tokei's (gitignore) syntax, on top of target, .git, .custodian and .claude. Repeats: one value per line, in order.
